lines.en: label beachfive16:
scene clearnightsky
The world will keep spinning regardless of if you’re sleeping or awake. Sometimes too fast. But even at its fastest, we never get dizzy. And I think that’s kind of cool.
lines.zh: 无论你是睡着还是醒着，世界都会继续转动。有时转得太快。但即便最快的时候，我们也从不头晕。我觉得这还挺酷的。

lines.en: I’m sure there’s some sort of fancy scientific explanation for it, but I’ve never cared much about science. There are plenty of things I’m fine with never understanding and rotation is just one more of them, I guess.
lines.zh: 我肯定这背后有某种高深的科学解释，但我从来不太在乎科学。有太多东西我不懂也无妨，自转大概只是其中之一吧。

lines.en: But for every single thing I don’t understand and every one I share with you, there are ten more that I do and I will.
lines.zh: 但我不懂的每一样、以及和你分享的每一样之外，还有十样是我懂的，而且我会懂的。

lines.en: So let’s talk about gates.
lines.zh: 那么，我们来聊聊门吧。

lines.en: scene onthebeach1
This is a torii. And while it doesn’t technically separate one plane or world or whatever you want to call them from the next, it does mark where normal transitions to abnormal.
lines.zh: 这是一座鸟居。虽然严格来说它并没有把一个位面、世界或者随便你怎么称呼的东西与下一个分隔开，但它确实标志着「正常」过渡到「异常」的地方。

lines.en: The gods are welcome through these gates. We keep the middle part of the path open for them. But we’re allowed to pass through as well since they have no way of stopping us.
lines.zh: 神明是被欢迎穿过这些门的。我们把路径的中间部分留给它们。但我们也可以穿过去，因为它们没办法阻止我们。

lines.en: And most of them don’t mind this.
lines.zh: 而它们大多数并不介意。

lines.en: But sometimes they do.
lines.zh: 但有时候它们介意。

lines.en: And sometimes, they either forget or overlook which side is the entrance altogether because a gate is still a gate no matter which side you pass through it from.
lines.zh: 而有时候，它们会彻底忘记或忽略哪一边才是入口——因为不管你从哪一侧穿过，门终究是门。

lines.en: Could it be that these structures that we’ve built with our own hands have been misunderstood by the gods?
lines.zh: 会不会是我们亲手建造的这些建筑，被神明误解了？

lines.en: Or are they now purposely reclaiming our world as their own as punishment for confining them to such small spaces?
lines.zh: 还是说，它们如今在故意把我们的世界收归己有，作为我们把它们禁锢在如此狭小空间里的惩罚？

lines.en: It was never our right to tell them where they can and can’t go. And to think a mere pocketful of coins would appease them is naught more than foolish and cruel.
lines.zh: 我们从来就没有权利规定它们能去哪里、不能去哪里。而以为区区一把硬币就能安抚它们，不过是愚蠢又残忍。

lines.en: If I were a god, I think I’d pass through gates from the opposite direction as well.
lines.zh: 如果我是神，我想我也会从相反的方向穿过那些门。

lines.en: I think I’d show the mortals that their world is {i}my{/i} world, not the other way around. And I’d see how happy {i}they’d{/i} be buying dinner with five yen coins.
lines.zh: 我想我会让凡人看看，他们的世界是{i}我的{/i}世界，而不是反过来。我还想看看{i}他们{/i}用五日元硬币买晚餐时能有多开心。

lines.en: I often wonder if the reason we have to experience as much pain as we do is merely because we’ve upset the wrong spirits. Or at least I {i}used{/i} to wonder that.
lines.zh: 我常想，我们之所以要承受这么多痛苦，会不会仅仅是因为我们惹错了神明。至少我{i}以前{/i}常这么想。

lines.en: I’ve all but confirmed it now with a little bit of elbow grease and a dollop of persistence. But do you want to hear what I want to do next?
lines.zh: 如今靠着一点汗水和一剂执着，我基本已经证实了这一点。但你想听听我接下来想做什么吗？

lines.en: I want to build a torii so big that the gods will know we welcome them everywhere — so we can always be in the shadow of entities more powerful than us.
lines.zh: 我想建一座大得让神明知道我们处处欢迎它们的鸟居——好让我们永远走在比我们更强大的存在的阴影之下。

lines.en: With all our flaws in tow, we’ll walk in the shadows of the divine, and we’ll laugh among our friends as we tell them which gods we’ve encountered this week.
lines.zh: 带着我们所有的缺陷，我们将走在神明的阴影里，在朋友之间笑着讲述这一周遇到了哪些神明。

lines.en: We’ll dine at the same restaurants...go swimming in the same community pool...and we’ll do it all knowing that we’ve managed to achieve something no other society or world ever has.
lines.zh: 我们会在同一家餐厅吃饭……在同一个社区泳池游泳……而做这一切时我们知道，自己达成了其他任何社会或世界都未曾达成的事。

lines.en: Perfect harmony.
lines.zh: 完美的和谐。

lines.en: And all it will take is a single gate big enough to welcome everyone- with a vacant spot in the middle that no man would ever dare to walk through on his own.
lines.zh: 而所需的，只是一道大到足以欢迎所有人的门——中间留一块空位，凡人绝不敢独自穿过。

lines.en: This is just a dream, though, of course.
lines.zh: 当然，这只是个梦而已。

lines.en: In reality, or at least {i}my{/i} reality, I already know how things end up. I know that no gate will ever be built.
lines.zh: 在现实中，或者至少在{i}我的{/i}现实中，我已经知道结局如何。我知道那道门永远不会建成。

lines.en: Maybe if I stayed, it would have been.
lines.zh: 也许如果我留下来，它会建成的。

lines.en: Maybe if it never started raining, it would have been.
lines.zh: 也许如果天从没开始下雨，它会建成的。

lines.en: scene black
I’ve got bad news for you.
lines.zh: 我有个坏消息要告诉你。

lines.en: This place is not as permanent as you think...and I know that because you can hear me.
lines.zh: 这个地方并不像你以为的那么永恒……而我知道这点，是因为你听得到我说话。

lines.en: But maybe that’s good news.
lines.zh: 但也许那是好消息。

lines.en: Maybe you want to leave.
lines.zh: 也许你想离开。

lines.en: Maybe you’re ready to meet me.
lines.zh: 也许你已经准备好见我了。

lines.en: Or maybe you’re just tired of not knowing which torii to avoid...and which ones to take shelter under in that tiny space that’s not quite real and not quite fake.
lines.zh: 或者也许你只是厌倦了不知道该避开哪座鸟居……以及该在哪座鸟居下、那块不算真实也不算虚假的狭小空间里躲雨。

lines.en: Whatever the case, I’ll keep you in my prayers and my thoughts.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我会把你留在我的祈祷和思念里。

lines.en: Just maybe not my sentences because everyone is getting tired of hearing about you by now.
lines.zh: 只是大概不会留在我的句子里，因为大家现在已经听腻了关于你的事。

lines.en: There’s one more thing.
lines.zh: 还有一件事。

lines.en: I can’t say it out loud, though.
lines.zh: 但我不能说出来。

lines.en: But that’s okay.
lines.zh: 不过没关系。

lines.en: I left it somewhere easy to find.
lines.zh: 我把它留在了一个容易找到的地方。

lines.en: Do me a favor, though...okay?
lines.zh: 不过帮我个忙……好吗？

lines.en: Don’t leave the room.
lines.zh: 别离开这个房间。

lines.en: scene onthebeach2
: Psst...
: ...Sana?
lines.zh: : ……Sana？

lines.en: : Weren’t you planning on {i}talking to me{/i} later, Sensei?...Don’t think I’m letting you off the hook just because Ayane filled me in on the important stuff...
lines.zh: : Sensei，你不是说要晚点{i}跟我谈谈{/i}吗？……别以为 Ayane 跟我说了重要的事，你就能蒙混过关……

lines.en: : What time is it?...
lines.zh: : 现在几点了？……

lines.en: : Late.
lines.zh: : 很晚了。

lines.en: : Sana-
lines.zh: : Sana——

lines.en: : Don’t worry...everyone’s asleep already. And if someone wakes up, then...
lines.zh: : 别担心……大家都已经睡了。要是有人醒了，那就……

lines.en: : Oh well. I guess they’ll know I’m the same as them after all.
lines.zh: : 那也没办法。我想她们终究会知道，我跟她们是一样的人。

lines.en: : You want to do this now? Here?
lines.zh: : 你想现在就谈？在这儿？

lines.en: : Who said anything about {i}here?{/i} Maybe I want to go for a long walk on the beach? We could even {i}hold hands{/i} if you think you can handle it.
lines.zh: : 谁说要在「{i}这儿{/i}」了？也许我想去海滩上走很长一段路？你要是觉得自己受得住，我们甚至可以{i}牵着手{/i}。

lines.en: : Can it really not wait until the morning?...
lines.zh: : 真的不能等到早上吗？……

lines.en: if beachfive15 == True:
: What’s wrong, Sensei? Still exhausted from what you and Ayane did in the shower? Are you worried a few minutes with this little girl will {i}kill{/i} you?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Sensei？还在为你和 Ayane 在淋浴间做的事疲惫不堪吗？你担心跟这个小姑娘待几分钟就会{i}要了你的命{/i}？

lines.en: : I don’t think it would {i}kill{/i} me but hell yes, I’m exhausted. I went all out in there.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得那会{i}要我的命{/i}，但操，我确实累坏了。我在里面可是全力以赴。

lines.en: : Now you’re just {i}trying{/i} to make me jealous.
lines.zh: : 你现在只是在{i}故意{/i}让我吃醋。

lines.en: : Sana...I’m tired.
lines.zh: : Sana……我累了。

lines.en: else:
: Why wait until the morning when we can be together now?
lines.zh: : 既然现在就能在一起，为什么要等到早上？

lines.en: : Because I’m fucking tired, that’s why.
lines.zh: : 因为我他妈的累了，就这个原因。

lines.en: : Then I guess I’ll just have to wake you up. I just hope I won’t be too loud.
lines.zh: : 那看来我只能负责把你弄醒了。我只希望自己不会太吵。

lines.en: : Ugh...fine.
lines.zh: : 呃……好吧。

lines.en: scene black
: I’m getting up. But it’s {i}your{/i} job to come up with an excuse for why we were both absent if someone notices.
lines.zh: : 我起来了。不过要是有人注意到我们俩都不在，编借口是{i}你的{/i}活儿。

lines.en: : Heheh...okay. I think I can manage that.
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿……好。我觉得我能搞定。

lines.en: Sana slides my bedroom door open and scans the room to make sure everyone is asleep.
lines.zh: Sana 拉开我卧室的门，扫视房间确认所有人都睡着了。

lines.en: scene onthebeach3

They were. And we’re {i}here{/i} now. But given that her words over the last ten minutes are at odds with her words from several hours ago, I’m not really sure what we’re even doing in the first place.
lines.zh: 她们确实都睡了。而我们现在就在{i}这儿{/i}。但考虑到她过去十分钟说的话和几小时前说的自相矛盾，我其实不太确定我们到底在干什么。

lines.en: : So...is this a sexual thing? Or is this actually a talking thing?
lines.zh: : 那么……这是要办事，还是真的要谈事？

lines.en: : Why not both?
lines.zh: : 为什么不能两样都有？

lines.en: : Because I’m not the best at multi-tasking. And because wanting me to finger you isn’t really a normal reaction to finding out that we’re caught in a timeloop.
lines.zh: : 因为我不太擅长一心二用。而且发现我们被困在时间循环之后，想让我用手帮你，并不是什么正常反应。

lines.en: : You actually believe that?
lines.zh: : 你真这么想？

lines.en: : Believe it? I’ve literally lived through it. Several times now. It was the whole reason I just spent like two months in my room.
lines.zh: : 想？我是真的经历过。到现在好几次了。那正是我刚刚在房间里待了差不多两个月的原因。

lines.en: : I thought you did that because you {i}lost{/i} somebody?
lines.zh: : 我以为你那样是因为{i}失去{/i}了某个人？

lines.en: : I did. To time. And the fact that I...didn’t play by the rules like I was supposed to.
lines.zh: : 是的。输给了时间。也因为我……没有按我该守的规则行事。

lines.en: : Whose rules?
lines.zh: : 谁的规则？

lines.en: : Some annoying voice inside of my head that’s been incessantly tormenting me ever since it happened. And while I’m sure that makes me sound crazy-
lines.zh: : 我脑子里某个讨厌的声音，从那件事之后就一直不停折磨我。虽然我知道这听起来很疯——

lines.en: : That doesn’t make you sound crazy, Sensei. I already told you I’ve been hearing my brother, haven’t I? And my dreams have only been getting weirder.
lines.zh: : 那并不让你听起来疯了，Sensei。我不是跟你说过我一直听得到我哥哥的声音吗？而且我的梦也越来越离谱了。

lines.en: scene onthebeach4

: It’s like every day I’m getting worse. Which is probably why finding out about this whole apocalyptic craziness doesn’t really seem {i}that{/i} crazy to me. Just another...weird thing to add to the list.
lines.zh: : 感觉我每天都在变差。这大概就是为什么，听说那些末日般的疯狂之事，我并不觉得有{i}那么{/i}疯狂。只是……又一件可以加进清单的怪事。

lines.en: : Maybe I’ll change my mind if I can actually see it firsthand. Ayane made it sound kind of cool.
lines.zh: : 也许等我亲眼见到，我就会改变想法。Ayane 说得还挺酷的。

lines.en: scene onthebeach3

: But what are {i}your{/i} thoughts on it as someone who apparently hates it so much? Because I figured a world where we all stay little would be {i}perfect{/i} for you. Is living forever {i}really{/i} that bad?
lines.zh: : 可作为一个显然如此厌恶这一切的人，{i}你{/i}是怎么想的？因为我以为，一个我们永远长不大的世界，对你来说应该是{i}完美{/i}的。永远活着{i}真的{/i}有那么糟吗？

lines.en: : Yes, when it isn’t actually “living forever.” All of us can still get sent back at any point in time. Like, you could go right back to being quiet and closed off after one bad night and I’d just have to deal with that.
lines.zh: : 是的，尤其当那并不是真正的「永远活着」。我们每个人都可能在任何时候被送回过去。比如，只要一个糟糕的夜晚，你就可能重新变回那个安静又封闭的人，而我就只能承受。

lines.en: : If that happens, can you promise me something?
lines.zh: : 如果真发生了，你能答应我一件事吗？

lines.en: : I can try. I just don’t know if it’ll be within my power since this world sort of indirectly influences everything I do.
lines.zh: : 我可以试试。只是我不确定那是否在我的能力范围内，毕竟这个世界间接地影响着我做的每件事。

lines.en: : Well, if you’re able to, don’t let me take so long to {i}wake up{/i} next time.
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果你能做到的话，下次别让我花那么久才「{i}醒过来{/i}」。

lines.en: : Because all that time I spent trying to keep things the way they were did nothing but put me at a disadvantage in the end.
lines.zh: : 因为我花在维持原状上的所有时间，到头来只是让我自己处于劣势。

lines.en: scene onthebeach5
: Like, maybe if I joined the race a little earlier, you never would have wanted anyone else at all?
lines.zh: : 比如，也许如果我早点加入这场赛跑，你就根本不会再想要别人了？

lines.en: : Yeah...maybe.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许吧。

lines.en: : So...apocalypse on a scale of one to ten. What would you give it?
lines.zh: : 那么……末日按一到十分，你打几分？

lines.en: : Ten on the aesthetic scale. One on the scale of its impact on my mental health. Ten on its ability to destroy everything I love.
lines.zh: : 美学上十分。对我心理健康的影响上一分。摧毁我所爱一切的能力上十分。

lines.en: : It hasn’t destroyed me yet.
lines.zh: : 它还没摧毁我呢。

lines.en: : No...it hasn’t.
lines.zh: : 不……还没有。

lines.en: : Are you afraid of dying, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你怕死吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Sorry...I know that’s a hard question.
lines.zh: : 抱歉……我知道这问题很难回答。

lines.en: : Does it make you uncomfortable?
lines.zh: : 让你不舒服了吗？

lines.en: : A little. I’ve been wondering that for a while and I’ve never been able to figure out an answer.
lines.zh: : 有一点。我想这个问题想了很久，从来没能找到答案。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Then let’s change positions to something that will make {i}both{/i} of us more comfortable...
lines.zh: : 那我们换个姿势，让我们{i}两个都{/i}更舒服一点吧……

lines.en: Sana inches forward and pushes aside my knees with hands so small that they can’t even fully cover them.
lines.zh: Sana 一点点挪过来，用那双小得甚至盖不住我膝盖的手把它们推开。

lines.en: She fits herself between my legs and presses her back against my chest, prompting me to wrap my arms around her because...
lines.zh: 她挤进我两腿之间，把背贴在我胸口，示意我用手臂环住她，因为……

lines.en: Because I want to.
lines.zh: 因为我想。

lines.en: scene onthebeach6
It’s as simple as that.
lines.zh: 就是这么简单。

lines.en: I think back to a dream I had — of the comfort she provided. And it’s the same way now.
lines.zh: 我想起自己做过的那个梦——她给予我的那种慰藉。而现在一模一样。

lines.en: But if Nodoka’s inkling truly spawned from the fountain of an unsleeping pen, maybe that wasn’t much of a {i}dream{/i} at all. Maybe it was an outcome.
lines.zh: 但如果 Nodoka 的直觉真是从一支不眠之笔的泉眼里涌出的，也许那根本算不上一个「{i}梦{/i}」。也许那是一种结局。

lines.en: I just wonder how many more nights and how many more moons I’d have to go through with this girl in my arms until such a thing became reality.
lines.zh: 我只是想知道，还要怀里的这个女孩陪我度过多少个夜晚、多少轮月亮，那样的事才会变成现实。

lines.en: : Comfy yet?
lines.zh: : 舒服了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. It’s weird, though. It’s like the closer you come, the smaller you get.
lines.zh: : 嗯。不过挺奇怪的。你越靠近，就显得越小。

lines.en: : Is that why there’s something hard poking me right now?
lines.zh: : 所以现在才有个硬硬的东西顶着我？

lines.en: : That’s just a reflex.
lines.zh: : 那只是条件反射。

lines.en: : I’m not afraid of dying, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我不怕死，Sensei。

lines.en: scene onthebeach7
: The {i}living{/i} part, though...{i}that{/i} is scary.
lines.zh: : 可是「{i}活着{/i}」这件事……{i}那{/i}才可怕。

lines.en: : There’s so much you need to worry about. So many things that can go wrong at any moment. And so few people who are able to make me feel safe.
lines.zh: : 需要担心的事太多了。有太多东西随时可能出错。而能让我感到安全的人又那么少。

lines.en: : You’re one of them. You...Ayane...and my mom- even {i}if{/i} she annoys me.
lines.zh: : 你是其中之一。你……Ayane……还有我妈妈——{i}哪怕{/i}她很烦人。

lines.en: : But what’s even scarier is that I’m going to have to hurt them when I steal your heart.
lines.zh: : 但更可怕的是，等我偷走你的心，我就不得不伤害她们。

lines.en: : You sound confident about that, Sana.
lines.zh: : 你听起来很有信心嘛，Sana。

lines.en: : I’ve gotta be confident when it comes to {i}something,{/i} don’t I?
lines.zh: : 我总得在{i}某件事{/i}上有信心，不是吗？

lines.en: scene onthebeach6
: Why don’t I make it you?...
lines.zh: : 那为什么不就把你当成那件事呢？……

lines.en: : I am afraid. Of dying, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我害怕。我是说，怕死。

lines.en: : Or...being reset. I’m not even sure how dying {i}works{/i} here after the whole debacle with Makoto’s dad.
lines.zh: : 或者……被重置。在 Makoto 的爸爸那档事之后，我甚至不确定在这里「死」是怎么{i}运作{/i}的。

lines.en: : I can speak from experience in saying it is quite permanent.
lines.zh: : 凭我的经验，那是相当不可逆的。

lines.en: : Your brother’s different, though. That happened before the loops started.
lines.zh: : 可你哥哥不一样。那是在循环开始之前发生的。

lines.en: scene onthebeach8
: Oh...yeah. I guess so.
lines.zh: : 哦……对。大概是吧。

lines.en: : So these things normally start at...the beginning of the school year, was it?
lines.zh: : 那么这些事通常是从……学年开始的时候发生的，是吧？

lines.en: : {i}Near{/i} the beginning.
lines.zh: : {i}接近{/i}开始的时候。

lines.en: : And they end at the end of it?
lines.zh: : 然后在学年结束的时候结束？

lines.en: : {i}Near{/i} the end of it.
lines.zh: : {i}接近{/i}结束的时候。

lines.en: : It would be way easier to keep track of them if it was just the start and the end, wouldn’t it?
